name: model
description: Model to use (e.g., gpt-5.5).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model behavior.

name: review_model
description: Optional model override used by /review (defaults to the current session model).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented review_model behavior.

name: model_provider
description: Provider id from model_providers (default: openai).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_provider behavior.

name: openai_base_url
description: Base URL override for the built-in openai model provider.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented openai_base_url behavior.

name: model_context_window
description: Context window tokens available to the active model.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_context_window behavior.

name: model_auto_compact_token_limit
description: Token threshold that triggers automatic history compaction (unset uses model defaults).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_auto_compact_token_limit behavior.

name: model_auto_compact_token_limit_scope
description: Controls whether the auto-compaction threshold counts the full active context (total, the default) or only growth after the carried compaction-window prefix (body_after_prefix).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_auto_compact_token_limit_scope behavior.

name: model_catalog_json
description: Enforce the JSON model catalog Codex uses at startup.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_catalog_json behavior.

name: oss_provider
description: Default local provider used when running with --oss (defaults to prompting if unset).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented oss_provider behavior.

name: approval_policy.granular.sandbox_approval
description: When true, sandbox escalation approval prompts are allowed to surface.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented approval_policy.granular.sandbox_approval behavior.

name: approval_policy.granular.rules
description: When true, approvals triggered by execpolicy prompt rules are allowed to surface.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented approval_policy.granular.rules behavior.

name: approval_policy.granular.mcp_elicitations
description: When true, MCP elicitation prompts are allowed to surface instead of being auto-rejected.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented approval_policy.granular.mcp_elicitations behavior.

name: approval_policy.granular.request_permissions
description: When true, prompts from the request_permissions tool are allowed to surface.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented approval_policy.granular.request_permissions behavior.

name: approval_policy.granular.skill_approval
description: When true, skill-script approval prompts are allowed to surface.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented approval_policy.granular.skill_approval behavior.

name: approvals_reviewer
description: Who reviews eligible approval prompts under on-request or granular approval policies. Defaults to user; auto_review uses the reviewer subagent. This setting doesn't change sandboxing or review actions already allowed inside the sandbox.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented approvals_reviewer behavior.

name: auto_review.policy
description: Local Markdown policy instructions for automatic review. Managed guardian_policy_config takes precedence. Blank values are ignored.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented auto_review.policy behavior.

name: allow_login_shell
description: Enforce whether shell tools can start a login shell.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented allow_login_shell behavior.

name: sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots
description: Additional writable roots when sandbox_mode = "workspace-write".
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots behavior.

name: sandbox_workspace_write.network_access
description: Allow outbound network access inside the workspace-write sandbox.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox_workspace_write.network_access behavior.

name: sandbox_workspace_write.exclude_tmpdir_env_var
description: Exclude $TMPDIR from writable roots in workspace-write mode.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox_workspace_write.exclude_tmpdir_env_var behavior.

name: sandbox_workspace_write.exclude_slash_tmp
description: Exclude /tmp from writable roots in workspace-write mode.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox_workspace_write.exclude_slash_tmp behavior.

name: windows.sandbox
description: Windows-only native sandbox mode when running Codex natively on Windows.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented windows.sandbox behavior.

name: windows.sandbox_private_desktop
description: Enforce whether the native Windows sandbox starts its child process on a private desktop.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented windows.sandbox_private_desktop behavior.

name: computer_use.windows.always_allowed_app_ids
description: Windows app identifiers that Computer Use can open without prompting. Apps not in the list require approval; remove saved entries from the ChatGPT desktop app's Computer Use settings.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented computer_use.windows.always_allowed_app_ids behavior.

name: notify
description: Command invoked for notifications; receives a JSON payload from Codex.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented notify behavior.

name: check_for_update_on_startup
description: Enforce whether Codex checks for updates when it starts.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented check_for_update_on_startup behavior.

name: feedback.enabled
description: Enforce whether users can submit feedback across Codex clients.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented feedback.enabled behavior.

name: analytics.enabled
description: Enable or disable analytics for this machine/profile. When unset, the client default applies.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented analytics.enabled behavior.

name: instructions
description: Reserved for future use; prefer model_instructions_file or AGENTS.md.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented instructions behavior.

name: developer_instructions
description: Additional developer instructions injected into the session (optional).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented developer_instructions behavior.

name: log_dir
description: Enforce the directory where Codex writes local log files.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented log_dir behavior.

name: sqlite_home
description: Enforce the directory where Codex stores SQLite-backed runtime state.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sqlite_home behavior.

name: compact_prompt
description: Inline override for the history compaction prompt.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented compact_prompt behavior.

name: model_instructions_file
description: Replacement for built-in instructions instead of AGENTS.md.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_instructions_file behavior.

name: personality
description: Default communication style for models that advertise supportsPersonality; can be overridden per thread/turn or via /personality.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented personality behavior.

name: service_tier
description: Preferred service tier for new turns. Use fast or another tier advertised by the active model; fast maps to the request value priority.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented service_tier behavior.

name: experimental_compact_prompt_file
description: Load the compaction prompt override from a file (experimental).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental_compact_prompt_file behavior.

name: skills.config
description: Per-skill enablement overrides stored in config.toml.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented skills.config behavior.

name: skills.config.<index>.path
description: Path to a skill folder containing SKILL.md.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented skills.config.<index>.path behavior.

name: skills.config.<index>.enabled
description: Enable or disable the referenced skill.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented skills.config.<index>.enabled behavior.

name: apps.<id>.enabled
description: Set to false to disable an app. A disabled requirement remains restrictive when multiple requirements sources are merged.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.enabled behavior.

name: apps._default.enabled
description: Default app enabled state for all apps unless overridden per app.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps._default.enabled behavior.

name: apps._default.destructive_enabled
description: Default allow/deny for app tools with destructive_hint = true.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps._default.destructive_enabled behavior.

name: apps._default.open_world_enabled
description: Default allow/deny for app tools with open_world_hint = true.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps._default.open_world_enabled behavior.

name: apps._default.approvals_reviewer
description: Default reviewer for app tool approval prompts unless overridden per app. When omitted, apps inherit the top-level approvals_reviewer value.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps._default.approvals_reviewer behavior.

name: apps._default.default_tools_approval_mode
description: Default approval behavior for app tools without per-app or per-tool overrides.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps._default.default_tools_approval_mode behavior.

name: apps.<id>.destructive_enabled
description: Allow or block tools in this app that advertise destructive_hint = true.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.destructive_enabled behavior.

name: apps.<id>.open_world_enabled
description: Allow or block tools in this app that advertise open_world_hint = true.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.open_world_enabled behavior.

name: apps.<id>.default_tools_enabled
description: Default enabled state for tools in this app unless a per-tool override exists.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.default_tools_enabled behavior.

name: apps.<id>.approvals_reviewer
description: Reviewer for this app's tool approval prompts. Overrides apps._default.approvals_reviewer.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.approvals_reviewer behavior.

name: apps.<id>.default_tools_approval_mode
description: Default approval behavior for tools in this app unless a per-tool override exists.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.default_tools_approval_mode behavior.

name: apps.<id>.tools.<tool>.enabled
description: Per-tool enabled override for an app tool (for example repos/list).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.tools.<tool>.enabled behavior.

name: apps.<id>.tools.<tool>.approval_mode
description: Set the managed approval mode for one app tool.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented apps.<id>.tools.<tool>.approval_mode behavior.

name: tool_suggest.discoverables
description: Allow tool suggestions for additional discoverable connectors or plugins. Each entry uses type = "connector" or "plugin" and an id.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tool_suggest.discoverables behavior.

name: tool_suggest.disabled_tools
description: Disable suggestions for specific discoverable connectors or plugins. Each entry uses type = "connector" or "plugin" and an id.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tool_suggest.disabled_tools behavior.

name: features.apps
description: Pin Apps integration availability on or off for managed users.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.apps behavior.

name: features.hooks
description: Enable lifecycle hooks loaded from hooks.json or inline [hooks] config. features.codex_hooks is a deprecated alias.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.hooks behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid this deprecated setting in new configuration; use the documented replacement when available.

name: features.code_mode.enabled
description: Enable code mode feature configuration. This feature is under development and off by default.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.code_mode.enabled behavior.

name: features.code_mode.excluded_tool_namespaces
description: Tool namespaces code mode excludes from nested code-mode tool guidance and executor exposure.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.code_mode.excluded_tool_namespaces behavior.

name: features.code_mode.direct_only_tool_namespaces
description: Tool namespaces code mode can use only through direct tool calls.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.code_mode.direct_only_tool_namespaces behavior.

name: features.rollout_budget.enabled
description: Enable rollout budget tracking. This feature is under development and off by default. When enabled, features.rollout_budget.limit_tokens is required.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.rollout_budget.enabled behavior.

name: features.rollout_budget.limit_tokens
description: Positive token limit for rollout budget tracking. Required when rollout budget is enabled.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.rollout_budget.limit_tokens behavior.

name: features.rollout_budget.reminder_interval_tokens
description: Positive token interval between rollout budget reminders. Defaults to 10% of limit_tokens, with a minimum of 1 token.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.rollout_budget.reminder_interval_tokens behavior.

name: features.rollout_budget.sampling_token_weight
description: Finite non-negative multiplier for sampled tokens in rollout budget accounting. Defaults to 1.0.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.rollout_budget.sampling_token_weight behavior.

name: features.rollout_budget.prefill_token_weight
description: Finite non-negative multiplier for prefill tokens in rollout budget accounting. Defaults to 1.0.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.rollout_budget.prefill_token_weight behavior.

name: hooks
description: Admin-enforced managed lifecycle hooks. Requires a managed hook directory and uses the same event schema as inline [hooks] in config.toml.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks behavior.

conditions: Admin-enforced managed lifecycle hooks. Requires a managed hook directory and uses the same event schema as inline [hooks] in config.toml.

name: hooks.<Event>
description: Matcher groups for a hook event such as PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, UserPromptSubmit, or Stop.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.<Event> behavior.

name: hooks.<Event>[].hooks
description: Hook handlers for a matcher group. Command and MCP tool hooks are supported while prompt and agent hook handlers are parsed but skipped.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.<Event>[].hooks behavior.

name: hooks.<Event>[].hooks[].async
description: Run a command hook in the background without delaying the triggering operation. Defaults to false; SessionEnd always runs synchronously. See Run hooks in the background.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.<Event>[].hooks[].async behavior.

name: hooks.<Event>[].hooks[].additionalContextLimit
description: Approximate per-handler token threshold for saving oversized additionalContext to disk and showing the model a shorter preview. Defaults to 2500; 0 passes the full context directly to the model. See Large hook output.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.<Event>[].hooks[].additionalContextLimit behavior.

name: hooks.<Event>[].hooks[].commandWindows
description: Windows-only command override for command hooks. The TOML alias command_windows is also accepted.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.<Event>[].hooks[].commandWindows behavior.

name: features.memories
description: Pin Memories availability on or off for managed users.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented features.memories behavior.

name: mcp_servers.<id>.command
description: Launcher command for an MCP stdio server.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented mcp_servers.<id>.command behavior.

name: mcp_servers.<id>.args
description: Arguments passed to the MCP stdio server command.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented mcp_servers.<id>.args behavior.
